requirements.requirement: Submit by 2026-10-16 2:30 PM CST; late proposals not accepted.
Submit one signed digital copy in the proper UA portal.
Authorized official signature required.
At least three current continental-US customer references relevant to requested services.
Higher-education references are preferred and explicitly considered in qualification scoring.
Proof of specified workers comp/employer liability, CGL and auto insurance in proposal.
Official price sheet and detailed pricing; proposal prices firm 120 days.
Comply with current counterpart Standard Terms and Conditions plus appendices.
Address/acknowledge every RFP section in chronological order.
Proposal may cover all services or a specific service; UA may split awards by service.
Single and joint bids acceptable; selected respondent(s) remain prime and sole buyer contact.
Technical proposal worth 40 points.
Respondent qualifications worth 30 points: profile, years, similar engagements, higher-ed references.
Cost worth 30 points, lowest cost receives max points and others formula-scaled.
Phased delivery months 1-3, 4-9, 9-13; 10-business-day correction of deficient deliverables at no added cost.
Continuous monitoring, audit evidence automation, evidence collection automation and control validation are within scope.
Secure research architecture, IAM, segmentation, third-party integration and scalability are within scope.
Represented personnel qualifications must be true; implementation/control-mapping errors require correction; audit/readiness support required.
Engagement concerns FCI/CUI and regulated research environments.
Buyer may issue addenda through planned 2026-10-05 date; bidder must monitor HogBid.
Complete applicable official signature forms listed in source_ledger.json; retain truthful disclosures and authorized signatures.
Review conditional accessibility evidence, proprietary/redacted packaging and EU personal-data obligations for the proposed service.
